user.title: Pair a TV
user.description: In Flick, open Settings → Home Assistant → TV connection → Pair TV. Enter the six-digit code shown on that TV.

confirm.title: Confirm this TV
confirm.description:
Pair **{name}** with Home Assistant? Choose a name such as Bedroom TV.

{replacement}

error.pairing_not_found: No TV is waiting with that code. Check the code and keep Flick's pairing screen open.
error.invalid_name: Enter a TV name with one to eighty characters.

abort.setup_failed: Flick could not start. Check the Home Assistant log and try again.
abort.pairing_expired: The pairing code expired. Generate a new code on the TV.
abort.reconfigured: The TV's pairing has been updated.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Choose a theme already available on this TV. Import additional themes in Flick’s Home screen → Theme settings. Launcher management must be enabled and an adult profile unlocked.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Enable Launcher management in Flick's TV connection settings first. Set a four-digit parent PIN for every adult before adding a child profile. A blank PIN keeps the existing one.

parent_pin.title: Change parent PIN
parent_pin.description: Use exactly four digits. The PIN is sent to the paired TV and is not saved in Home Assistant's integration options.

delete_profile.title: Delete profile
delete_profile.description: Delete the selected profile from the TV. At least one adult profile must remain.

wallpaper.title: Slideshow
wallpaper.description: Only the preferences entered here change. Choose photo folders and local pictures on the TV; use the Set wallpapers action for online collections.

home_text.title: Home screen text
home_text.description: Enter text or a Home Assistant template. Leave blank to hide it. Long output is shortened on the TV.

error.theme_unavailable: This theme is no longer available. Choose another theme.
error.invalid_template: Enter a valid text template with at most 8192 characters. Check it in Developer tools → Template.
error.command_failed: Connect the TV, enable Launcher management in Flick and unlock an adult profile. Adult profiles need a PIN when children are configured.

abort.theme_unavailable: This TV does not support theme selection. Update Flick and reconnect the TV.
abort.command_failed: Connect the TV, enable Launcher management in Flick and unlock an adult profile.
abort.profile_limit: This TV already has twelve profiles. Remove a profile before adding another.
